text: Titles and summaries that opened with "Prompt asks to…" or "The assistant…" narrated the transcript instead of stating the outcome, so semantic.ts now returns a node's own text verbatim, without a model call, when it already fits the granularity length (90 / 300 / 800 characters). The summarizer instruction now bans narration and receives the reader's heading so the text adds to it, ANALYZER_VERSION is bumped to 2, Zoom.tsx hides a body that only repeats its heading, and nine cached meta-phrased summaries were deleted for regeneration. Haiku now titles the project.json turn "Project index and cursors leave the repo; per-session meta.json replaces it", and 51 tests pass, including a new short-node test (commit b9ae2e0, not pushed).
